ctx.x: first engagement with her, I think it was in a club in Baltimore. Then we played a couple of places, and then we went to Chicago, and we played at a club there called the Blue Note, which was run by a guy, Frank... Oh boy! I mention him because he was a very fine guy, and he was crazy about Sarah Vaughan, and Sarah used to play there at least three or four times a year.

But when we got into Chicago, Sarah made arrangements to have a trio. She knew a couple of fellows in Chicago, a bass player who I had heard about since the late Thirties, who was a legend among bass players. The first I heard about him was when he was working with Fletcher Henderson, and from what I understand, he was a teenager at that particular. But this fellow's name was Israel Crosby. Which I have worked with a lot of bass players... I have worked with a lot of bass players before and since, and I have…
